In [[3653 BBY]], a '''skirmish''' took place in the [[Liston Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] hunted down [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] after Malgus [[Death/Legends|killed]] her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Ven Zallow]], during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. She found him with the help of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]], and [[Duel in the ruins of the Jedi Temple|dueled]] him first in the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. The [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] ended in a draw, and Leneer again sought Malgus out, finally creating a plan to lure him to her by attacking his lover, [[Eleena Daru]], in the [[Liston Spaceport]]. Leneer knocked Daru out and awaited Malgus, while Korr fled the planet in a [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship|drop ship]], engaging in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|combat]] with its [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrath Xizor]]. Malgus arrived and again dueled Leneer, finally defeating her with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]]. However, he believed that he owed her a debt&mdash;she had shown him his weakness in his love for Daru, and thus allowed Leneer to flee. Korr, meanwhile, defeated Xizor, and when the man threatened his family, Korr pushed him out the [[Dropship/Legends|drop ship's]] [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Malgus then killed Daru to eliminate his weakness, and Korr and Leneer eventually met on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where they lived together.

==Prelude==
In [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] launched an invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], instigating the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> However, in [[3653 BBY]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] offered to negotiate with the Republic for peace. The truce was a ploy, however; during the [[Alderaan peace conference]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] had led an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Sith defeated the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] there and took temporary hold of Coruscant, establishing a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. During the battle, Malgus [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]]. Zallow's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]], was attending the Peace Conference. She felt her Master's death, and overcome with grief and anger, she determined to find and kill Zallow's murderer.<ref name="Dec" />

Leneer located an old friend, former Republic [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Zeerid Korr]], and enlisted his help in getting her through the Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] on Coruscant. He was already planning to go to Coruscant in order to [[Smuggler/Legends|deliver]] a shipment of [[engspice]], an illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]], with a payoff so large that he could retire and live with his disabled [[Arra Yooms|daughter]]. They were shot down while running the blockade, causing the spice shipment to be detsroyed, but they survived, jumping out of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] while Leneer used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|slow their descent]] to the ground. They then traveled to the ruins of the Jedi Temple, where they found a [[Holorecorder/Legends|recording]] of the attack that showed Malgus killing Zallow. Malgus, meanwhile, traveled in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] down to the ruins, where Leneer met and [[Duel in the ruins of the Jedi Temple|dueled]] him. Korr, however, intervened, and fled with Leneer in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].<ref name="Dec" />

While scouting around the [[Liston Spaceport]], Korr located the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Eleena Daru]], a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and lover of Malgus who had also participated in the attack on the Temple. Despite Korr's efforts to convince Leneer to let go of her vengeance and leave the planet with him, she and Korr traveled to the small [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. There, they caused a diversion with the help of Zallow's [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] and found Daru in one of the [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]]. Meanwhile, Malgus began to fear for his lover and traveled to the spaceport, looking for her.<ref name="Dec" />

==The skirmish==
Leneer approached Daru, who quickly drew her [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and opened fire. The Jedi deflected the shots away and knocked the Twi'lek out. Korr attempted one last time to convince her to leave, and although she had finally let go of her anger, she declined. Korr then attempted to commandeer a nearby [[Dragonfly-class Imperial drop ship|drop ship]], [[Razor (Dragonfly-class)|''Razor'']], and fled. Meanwhile, Malgus arrived and attacked Leneer, and the two [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|dueled]] once more. Meanwhile, the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the ''Razor'', former Imperial [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Vrath Xizor]]&mdash;who had recently been hired as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] to prevent Korr from delivering his shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to Coruscant&mdash;found Korr on his ship and confronted him.<ref name="Dec" />

Malgus finally defeated Leneer with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], knocking her out. However, he declined to kill her, instead deciding that he had simply returned a debt&mdash;she had shown him that Daru was a weakness he could not afford. Leneer was surprised by his decision, but she fled the planet. Korr, meanwhile, defeated Xizor in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]] and held him captive. When Xizor began to threaten Korr's family, however, Korr realized that he could not allow the man to live, and pushed him out of the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]]. Back on Coruscant, Daru reawakened, and Malgus [[Shiak|stabbed]] her through the [[Heart/Legends|heart]] with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], knowing that as long as she lived, she would be a weakness for him.<ref name="Dec" />

==Aftermath==
Korr returned to his family on the planet [[Vulta]] and took his daughter to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], where he began a new life as a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]]. Leneer eventually found him there, and agreed to stay there and live with him. Malgus finally [[Duel in Adraas's manse|attacked]] his rival, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Adraas]], in [[Adraas's manse]], killing him.
